title: Temporal Standardization and Parsing
description: Standardization of temporal representations into unified UTC timestamps and clean date parts.
conditions: Heterogeneous date formats in raw data sources
Longitudinal time-series analysis or survival duration modeling
recommended_methods: Strict strptime parsing with explicit format strings
UTC timezone conversion via standard datetime libraries
Feature engineering of calendar components (year, month, day_of_week, is_weekend)
selection_rules: Never use ambiguous dateutil auto-parsing on financial or medical transactional dates
If timezone is absent, document default assumed timezone (e.g. UTC) in metadata manifest
Convert duration between two timestamps into standardized floating point units (days, hours)
limitations: Historical dates prior to 1970 (Unix epoch) can cause integer overflow in older legacy systems
Leap seconds and daylight savings shifts can create negative elapsed durations
